title: Backpack Feature Explorer
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D backpack feature explorer using Three.js. Load the 3D model 'Corset.glb' using GLTFLoader from a CDN (use the Khronos sample: ../../../assets/shared/Corset.glb). This model serves as the product to explore.

SCENE SETUP:
- Create a scene with a gradient background (top: #1a1a2e, bottom: #16213e) using a canvas texture or two-tone background.
- Add a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 0.15, 0.5) looking at origin.
- Add an AmbientLight (intensity 0.4, color #ffffff) and a DirectionalLight at (2, 3, 2) with intensity 1.2 and castShadow=true.
- Add a second DirectionalLight at (-1, 1, -1) with intensity 0.5 (fill light).
- Place a circular platform (CylinderGeometry, radius 0.2, height 0.01) beneath the model with MeshStandardMaterial (color: #2a2a4a, metalness: 0.8, roughness: 0.2).
- The Corset model should be scaled to fit nicely (scale ~3.0 on all axes) and centered on the platform.
- Enable shadow mapping on the renderer.

FEATURE HOTSPOTS:
- Create 5 clickable hotspot markers (small spheres, radius 0.008, color #ff6b35) positioned around the model at these approximate positions relative to the model center:
  - Hotspot 1 'Stitching Detail': position (0.05, 0.12, 0.04)
  - Hotspot 2 'Material Quality': position (-0.04, 0.08, 0.05)
  - Hotspot 3 'Lacing System': position (0.0, 0.1, 0.06)
  - Hotspot 4 'Structural Support': position (0.03, 0.04, 0.04)
  - Hotspot 5 'Edge Finishing': position (-0.03, 0.14, 0.03)
- Each hotspot should pulse (scale oscillation between 1.0 and 1.8 using sin wave).
- When a hotspot is clicked (raycasting), it should highlight (change color to #00ff88), the camera should smoothly animate (TWEEN or lerp over 60 frames) to zoom into that area, and an info panel should appear.

INFO PANEL (DOM):
- Create a div with id='info-panel' positioned on the right side (right: 20px, top: 50%, transform: translateY(-50%)), width 280px, initially hidden (display:none).
- It should have a title (h3 with id='feature-title'), description (p with id='feature-desc'), and a close button (id='close-panel').
- Style with background rgba(26,26,46,0.95), border-left: 3px solid #ff6b35, color white, padding 20px, border-radius 8px.
- Feature descriptions: Hotspot1='Premium double-stitched seams for durability', Hotspot2='Full-grain leather with natural patina aging', Hotspot3='Adjustable cross-lacing with brass eyelets', Hotspot4='Internal boning provides structured silhouette', Hotspot5='Hand-finished rolled edges prevent fraying'.

ROTATION CONTROLS:
- Auto-rotate the model at 0.3 radians/sec around Y-axis by default.
- Pressing 'Space' toggles auto-rotation on/off.
- Pressing 'A' rotates model left by 0.1 radians per press.
- Pressing 'D' rotates model right by 0.1 radians per press.
- Pressing 'R' resets rotation to 0 and re-enables auto-rotate.

COLOR THEMES:
- Add 3 DOM buttons at bottom center: id='theme-classic' (label 'Classic', color #8B4513), id='theme-modern' (label 'Modern', color #2c3e50), id='theme-luxury' (label 'Luxury', color #c9a84c).
- Clicking a theme button changes: the platform material color, the directional light color tint, and a CSS class on the body.
- Classic: platform=#8B4513, light=#ffeedd. Modern: platform=#2c3e50, light=#e0e0ff. Luxury: platform=#c9a84c, light=#fff5e0.

ZOOM CONTROLS:
- Mouse wheel zooms camera in/out along its forward vector. Min distance 0.25, max distance 1.0 from origin.
- Add a DOM element id='zoom-level' showing current zoom percentage (100% at default 0.5, 200% at 0.25, 50% at 1.0). Formula: zoomPercent = Math.round((0.5 / cameraDistance) * 100).

STATE MANAGEMENT:
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
  - modelLoaded: boolean (true once GLB is loaded)
  - modelRotationY: number (current Y rotation in radians of the model group)
  - autoRotate: boolean
  - activeHotspot: number (0 for none, 1-5 for which hotspot is active)
  - panelVisible: boolean
  - currentTheme: string ('classic'|'modern'|'luxury'), default 'classic'
  - cameraDistance: number (distance from camera to origin)
  - zoomPercent: number
  - hotspotClickCount: number (total clicks on hotspots)
  - platformColor: string (hex color of platform)

HUD:
- Top-left: product name 'ARTISAN CORSET' in white, font-size 24px, id='product-title'.
- Below it: 'Explore features by clicking the orange markers' in #aaa, font-size 12px, id='product-subtitle'.
- Top-right: id='rotation-indicator' showing current rotation in degrees (0-360, wrapped).

ENSURE:
- All animations use requestAnimationFrame.
- Raycasting works correctly for hotspot clicks.
- Camera transitions are smooth (use lerp or similar).
- The model and hotspots rotate together as a group.
- No NaN values in any state fields.
- The scene is responsive to window resize.
physics_constraints: Auto-rotation at 0.3 rad/s when enabled. Camera distance clamped to [0.25, 1.0]. Rotation values must remain finite (no NaN/Infinity). Hotspot pulse uses sinusoidal scaling between 1.0-1.8. Camera zoom interpolation must be smooth and bounded.
